##### Bioavailability of Vitamin D3  
Among forms of Vitamin D Vitamin D3 is the most easily absorbed by the body making it highly effective compared to Vitamin D2 in maintaining adequate levels of this vital nutrient in the bloodstream. Taking Vitamin D3 supplements can more effectively help ensure health and prevent deficiencies.

##### Can I take Vitamin D3 supplements with other medications?  
Vitamin D3 supplements may interact with medications like corticosteroids and weight loss drugs. If you are taking medication or have underlying health conditions it’s essential to consult with our healthcare professionals before introducing Vitamin D3 supplements.
